If you fix LCD monitors here is a handy diagnostic if the screen is black but power light is on or erratic. No picture, so it's not the backlight. Maybe driver or power supply. Power button also won't turn it off. OK, that's main power supply. Probably ~$5 capacitors. t.co

video

1538339414920814594.a: Could be a DC to DC convertor module but those usually just explode when they fail and the entire system is dead.

1538339798431195137.a: Hold a flashlight with the lens flat against the screen. When the matrix gets powered up it will try to go opaque for a split second before the backlight inverter kicks in.

1538339981109903361.a: Which of course allows the flashlight to hit the reflector and shine back at you.
